key_insight: BAR helps an LLM reason over medical knowledge graphs with budget limits while keeping evidence traceable and citeable.
clinical_relevance: This could improve post-discharge risk prediction by adding verifiable external medical knowledge when EHR records miss important causal links.
method: Builds disease-specific evidence graphs with support scores and provenance.
Uses a plan-navigate-verify loop to retrieve KG evidence under a patient budget.
Trains a policy with prediction gain, acquisition cost, and citation-integrity rewards.
evidence_signal: On MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV across 8 diseases and 3 horizons, BAR improved AUPRC by 3.4 points over the strongest baseline, increased citation precision from 59.8% to 77.9%, and used 62-65% of the budget cap.
watch_item: Performance depends on KG quality and provenance; citation accuracy does not guarantee clinical correctness or generalization outside the evaluated datasets.
paper_title: Cite What You Explore: Budget-Aware LLM Reasoning over Medical KGs with Verifiable Evidence
